proof_groups.proof_strategy: For the entail witness, choose the first Coq-level disjunct, substitute nodes_strong_spec using PreH1, and apply the existing xizi_dll_split_at_node__dll_cut_split_reconnect entailment to obtain node_next, node_prev, non-nullness, the shifted prefix, all four boundary fields, and the shifted suffix. For the return witness, choose the first disjunct and apply the existing xizi_dll_remove_result__dll_cut_split_reconnect entailment; it reconnects the remaining circle and folds the removed node's self-linked fields into xizi_dll linklist_node_pre nil. Close only by direct unfolding, existential instantiation, sep_apply/cancel, and entailer-style steps.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Both witnesses are the same operational cut/update/reconnect phase and are already covered by the same existing case-lib helper family; proving them sequentially preserves the shared spatial context and requires no new helper.

Tail uses head_strong_spec=head_remove_tail_spec, nodes_strong_spec=prefix_remove_tail_spec ++ [linklist_node_pre], prefix_strong_spec=prefix_remove_tail_spec, suffix_strong_spec=nil. Front uses head_strong_spec=head_remove_front_spec, nodes_strong_spec=linklist_node_pre :: suffix_remove_front_spec, prefix_strong_spec=nil, suffix_strong_spec=suffix_remove_front_spec. Member first applies xizi_dll_remove_first_split__spec_derivations_direct to the In premise, obtaining prefix/suffix, the first-hit decomposition, and xizi_dll_remove_first equality, then uses those values. In every case retain the input xizi_dll as the strong pre, introduce the post wand, normalize app/nil or rewrite by the remove-first equality, and close the identity transformation by direct separation-logic tactics.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses derive a user-facing removal contract from the same strong spec by existential instantiation and an identity post wand; only the member case adds the already-proved first-hit list split. They share one proof pattern and helper family.
